Job Description: About Broadcom VMware by Broadcom is a leader in datacenter infrastructure, networking, security, and virtualization software. We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Engineer to join the Application Networking and Security (ANS) division. About the ANS Team ANS is a fast-paced, tight-knit team providing advanced security solutions such as Distributed Firewall and Rule Recommendation, Network Traffic Anomalies Detection, Network Flows Visualization and Monitoring, Intrusion Detection and Prevention and Malware Prevention. About the Role We are looking for a skilled DevOps Engineer to streamline our software development lifecycle, automate infrastructure workflows, and enhance deployment reliability. You will bridge the gap between development and operations by managing version control, maintaining robust CI/CD pipelines, and leveraging modern scripting and AI-driven automation tools. Key Responsibilities • CI/CD Pipeline Management: Design, build, and maintain automated Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using Jenkins to ensure fast, reliable code delivery. • Version Control & Build Systems: Manage source code repositories, branching strategies, and merge workflows using Git, while optimizing build systems for speed and consistency. • System Administration: Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot Linux-based servers and environments to ensure high availability, performance, and security. • Automation & Scripting: Write clean, maintainable scripts in Python to automate repetitive operational tasks, system checks, and deployment workflows. • AI-Assisted Operations: Integrate modern AI tools (such as AI coding assistants, automated code-review bots, or AIOps monitoring tools) into daily workflows to accelerate troubleshooting, script generation, and anomaly detection. • Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner closely with software developers, QA engineers, and security teams to resolve build failures, manage releases, and enforce DevOps best practices. Required Skills & Qualifications • Experience: 3-5 years of experience in software product. • Education: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science. • Version Control: Strong hands-on experience with Git (GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket), including branching models, pull requests, and conflict resolution. • CI/CD & Build Tools: Proven experience setting up and administering Jenkins (declarative/scripted pipelines, plugins, webhooks) and familiarity with build tools (e.g., Maven, Gradle, npm, or Make). • Operating Systems: Solid command-line proficiency in Linux (Ubuntu, CentOS, RHEL), including process management, networking basics, permissions, and shell scripting. • Programming/Scripting: Practical experience writing automation scripts and utilities using Python. • AI Tooling: Familiarity with using AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT/LLMs, or AI-powered log analysis/observability tools) to improve engineering productivity and operational efficiency. • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills with the ability to diagnose pipeline bottlenecks, build errors, and environment issues quickly. Nice-to-Have Qualifications • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes). • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform). title: Senior Java Developer
description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role About the role Bring your specialist knowledge and experience to a company managing 50% of the world’s MIPS and play a critical role in our modernization mission. You’ll join a global community of experts who share knowledge openly and collaborate freely to shape the future of Java modernization. In this position, you will design, build, and maintain high-volume business logic while refactoring legacy code to enable seamless integration with modern cloud and mobile applications. Beyond technical execution, you will bring strong leadership skills to guide and mentor an offshore engineering team over the long term. Key Responsibilities Microservices Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable microservices using Java 17+ and Spring Boot 4. Event Streaming & Kafka: Implement real-time event streaming solutions using Apache Kafka to consume, transform, enrich, and publish streaming data. Data Integration & Persistence: Implement change-detection logic, publish event updates, and optimize data persistence within MySQL databases. Cloud & Resiliency Architecture: Deploy and manage applications on Microsoft Azure PaaS, ensuring fault-tolerant, scalable, and highly available streaming architectures. Reliability & Testing: Configure robust retry mechanisms, dead-letter topics, and idempotent processing while writing comprehensive unit, integration, and performance tests. DevOps & Delivery: Collaborate closely with DevOps teams to implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines. Team Leadership: Mentor and guide an offshore development team to foster technical growth and ensure delivery excellence. Database Management: Proficiency in MySQL database integration, query optimization, and implementing change-data capture/detection patterns. Distributed Systems Reliability: Demonstrated ability to build resilient systems utilizing idempotent processing, fault-tolerant design, retry handling, and dead-letter queues. Your future at Kyndryl This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience Required 10 years+ Experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects. Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem-solving skills. Software development methodologies, with demonstrated experience developing scalable and robust software. Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, REST-based web services. Knowledge of architecture design - Microservices architecture, containers (Docker & k8s), messaging queues. Deep understanding of OOP and design patterns. Preferred Qualifications Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) - otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl. Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! title: Staff Software Engineer- Test
description: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon. Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place. About the role We're hiring an SDET-2 (Software Development Engineer in Test) in Bengaluru to own quality for the services our customers depend on. You'll decide what to test and how, build and maintain automation, test by hand where it finds problems fastest, and help the team ship often without breaking customers. Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. Quality is a first-class priority for us, not a phase at the end. You'll work closely with developers, Product, Customer Support and your Engineering Manager. What you'll own in your first year Own: Own quality for a service or product area end to end — test strategy, automation, release sign-off, and follow-up on escaped bugs. Test strategy. Decide what to automate, what to test by hand, and what risk is acceptable for each release. Automation that lasts. Build and extend API, UI and integration test suites that are fast, reliable and run in CI on every change. Shift left. Review designs and requirements early, and work with developers so testability is built in, not bolted on. Learn from escapes. When a bug reaches customers, find out why and close the gap so it doesn't happen again. Raise the bar. Review test code, mentor SDET-1s, and help interview candidates. What you must bring These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job. Experience: 2–5 years in software testing or development. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone. You've built automation that runs in CI. Test suites you designed or substantially extended, that run on every change and that the team trusts. You own quality, not just test cases. You've decided what to test for a feature or release, and stood behind the call. You are comfortable testing by hand. You use manual and exploratory testing deliberately, where it finds problems faster than scripts. You work independently toward a clear goal. Given a feature or release, you plan the testing, unblock yourself, and raise risks early. Test plan Breakdown: You can take product requirements and create deep test plan including all corner cases to ensure Quality We care how you test more than which tool you did it in. Technical background You've tested production systems with a modern stack, such as: Languages: strong in at least one language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript — you write test code with the same care as product code. Test automation: frameworks such as Pytest, JUnit/TestNG, Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, including structuring a suite so it stays maintainable. APIs and services: contract and integration testing of REST APIs, including error paths, auth and data validation. CI and cloud: running tests in CI pipelines, and testing services deployed on AWS — reading logs and metrics to diagnose failures. Databases: SQL to set up and verify data, and an understanding of how data issues show up as bugs. Non-functional testing: exposure to performance or load testing with tools such as JMeter, k6 or Locust. Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome. What sets great candidates apart Impact you can explain. Escaped bugs went down, release time went down, or flaky tests went away — and you can say what you did to get there. A suite you made better. You took slow or flaky automation and made it fast and trusted, not just bigger. Framework mindset: You spot repeated test code and turn it into reusable helpers, fixtures or tooling others build on. Root-cause thinking. You trace a failure to its cause in code, data or config, not just report the symptom. Product sense. title: Software Engineer
description: About Parexel Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere. We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®. About the Role We are seeking a clinical technology professional to join our team. As a Veeva Vault Configuration Developer, you will support clinical research activities that advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in configuring the Veeva Vault solutions that support study startup, trial management, and document management, ensuring each change follows validated, change-controlled processes from development through release. Responsibilities include implementing and maintaining Vault configurations, performing unit testing, supporting validation activities, and troubleshooting production issues, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence how clinical teams work every day. You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through accurate, well-tested configuration, reliable production support, and clear technical documentation. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Veeva Vault Configuration Developer can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research technology. Key Responsibilities Implement Veeva Vault configuration changes based on approved requirements and technical designs. Configure and maintain Vault objects, fields, relationships, document types, metadata, document and object lifecycles, and workflows. Configure and maintain user actions, state-change actions, notifications, roles, permissions, and security settings, as well as reports, dashboards, checklists, and milestones. Follow configuration standards and best practices established by senior developers and architects. Support configuration activities across CTMS, eTMF, Study Startup, and Site Connect, as applicable. Perform unit testing of configuration changes and document the results. Support informal testing, SIT, UAT, and validation activities. Fix configuration defects identified during testing. Maintain configuration and technical documentation. Support the investigation of Veeva production incidents and user issues. Troubleshoot basic-to-intermediate issues involving workflows, permissions, document visibility, lifecycle states, notifications, and configuration. Perform initial root-cause analysis and escalate complex issues to senior developers or architects. You'll thrive in this role if you bring Strengths in analyzing existing workflows, lifecycles, objects, and security configurations before making changes, and in troubleshooting configuration issues. Strong clinical systems experience or a background in a regulated environment, along with a willingness to develop Veeva expertise. The ability to learn quickly and work effectively under guidance from senior developers and technical leads. A commitment to quality, with strong attention to detail in testing and documentation. Comfort working within configuration, validation, release, and change-control standards. Required Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in technical discipline (Mathematics, Science, Engineering, Computing, etc.) or a related study, or equivalent project-related experience. 1 to 3 years of experience in application configuration, development, or clinical technology. Basic understanding of Vault objects and fields, documents and metadata, lifecycles, workflows, roles and permissions, and reports and dashboards. Ability to implement low-to-medium complexity Vault configuration changes with guidance. Understanding of software development lifecycle and change management processes, and a basic understanding of GxP, validated systems, and regulated application delivery. Familiarity with Azure DevOps or Jira for stories, tasks, and defects. Ability to perform unit testing and document results, and to troubleshoot configuration and production issues. Good analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Veeva Vault, or strong clinical systems experience with a willingness to develop Veeva expertise. Exposure to Veeva Vault Clinical, particularly CTMS, eTMF, Study Startup, or Site Connect. Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, or another regulated environment. We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research. If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

title: Senior Business Intelligence Developer
description: Business Unit: Cubic Transportation Systems Company Details: When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners. We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com. Job Details: Job Summary The Senior BI Developer is a senior technical leader within CTS’s Global Analytics function, based in the CDI team in Hyderabad. The role is the subject matter expert (SME) for Microsoft Power BI and owns the design, development and ongoing evolution of analytical assets - semantic data models, interactive dashboards, reports and data products - built on Power BI and backed by Azure SQL and Oracle data sources. Working closely with the UK-based BI Team Lead, Engineering and Services teams, the Senior BI Developer leads the end-to-end delivery of BI solutions for the TOC program and other global programs across domains such as ridership, sales, device performance and service operations. The role pairs deep technical skill with advanced UI/UX design capability, turning complex operational, performance and customer datasets into intuitive, visually polished analytical experiences that drive service excellence, contractual KPI/SLA compliance and continuous improvement. The role also provides technical mentoring to more junior developers in the team. This position works under general direction and takes ownership of deliverables with minimal supervision. Key Responsibilities Power BI Development & Analytical Assets Design, build and maintain enterprise Power BI solutions, including star-schema semantic models, DAX measures, calculation groups, row-level security, incremental refresh and scheduled refresh. Develop reusable analytical assets – certified datasets, templates, themes, KPI frameworks and metric definitions – that enable consistent, self-service analytics across programs. Optimize Power BI performance, including model design, DAX tuning, query folding, aggregations and capacity usage (e.g. using DAX Studio, Performance Analyzer). Manage workspaces, deployment pipelines, gateways, refresh schedules and governance practices in the Power BI Service. Dashboard & UI/UX Design Apply advanced UI/UX and data visualization design to create intuitive, accessible, on-brand dashboards, including custom layouts, themes (JSON), navigation, drill-through, bookmarks, tooltips and mobile views. Design for user needs: run discovery sessions, wireframe and prototype with stakeholders, and iterate based on feedback and usage analytics. Define and uphold dashboard design standards and storytelling best practice across the team. Build custom visuals and use tools such as Figma, Deneb/Vega or SVG-driven visuals where they add value (preferred). SQL Development & Data Integration Develop and maintain complex, performant SQL (T-SQL for Azure SQL / SQL Server and PL/SQL for Oracle), including stored procedures, views, functions, indexing and execution-plan tuning. Design and build data pipelines and transformations (e.g. Azure Data Factory, Power Query, SSIS) integrating data from multiple operational systems, ODS/EDW and customer sources. Design and maintain dimensional data models and analytical datasets that serve Power BI and other consumers. Perform data wrangling, cleansing, reconciliation and defect investigation to ensure reported figures are accurate, consistent and explainable. Data Analysis & Insights Conduct data analysis and deliver actionable insights to support project and BAU requirements across regional and global teams. Support root cause analysis (RCA), impact assessments and KPI/SLA performance monitoring through interactive dashboards. Provide scheduled and ad-hoc analysis and reporting to key business units, ensuring timely and accurate delivery. Requirements, Solution Design & Collaboration Participate in requirements gathering workshops with internal and external stakeholders (including UK-based customers and the BI Team Lead), translating business needs into well-defined technical specifications. Contribute to solution design and architecture decisions for new and existing BI environments, aligned to best practice and long-term scalability. Partner with Engineering and Services teams on data architecture and delivery. Champion BI development standards, including documentation, naming conventions, code review, testing and version control (e.g. Git, deployment pipelines). SAP BusinessObjects & Legacy Support (Secondary) Maintain and support existing SAP BusinessObjects solutions (WebI, Crystal Reports, universes via IDT) and SSRS reports where required. Support migration and rationalization of legacy reports onto Power BI, including gap analysis and validation against existing outputs. Support, Mentoring & Continuous Improvement Provide responsive production support for reporting and data issues, including incident triage, root cause analysis and resolution. Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior developers and analysts in the CDI team; review their work for quality. Identify and implement automation and process improvements that reduce manual reporting effort. Present analytical findings and solutions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including UK-based stakeholders. General Duties and Responsibilities Comply with Cubic’s Quality Management System. Comply with Cubic Occupational Health, Safety and Environment policies and procedures. Comply with security in accordance with established policies and procedures of the organisation. Comply with Cubic Human Resources procedures. Other duties as requested. Required Skills and Qualifications Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field. 6+ years’ experience in Business Intelligence related roles, with significant recent hands-on Power BI experience (data modelling, DAX, Power Query, Power BI Service). Strong SQL skills across both Azure SQL / SQL Server (T-SQL) and Oracle (PL/SQL), including query optimization and performance tuning. Proven ability to design and develop analytical assets (semantic models, certified datasets, KPI frameworks), not just consume them. Advanced dashboard UI/UX design skills, with a portfolio or demonstrable examples of polished, user-centered Power BI work. Strong understanding of relational database design and dimensional modelling. Strong background in RCA, impact analysis and operational performance analytics, and experience working with very large, multi-source datasets. Experience partnering with engineering teams on data architecture and delivery. Preferred Skills Experience with Azure data services (Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Fabric) and Microsoft BI tools (SSIS, SSAS, SSRS). Experience with AWS Experience with Python, R or machine learning; exposure to predictive maintenance or device health analytics. Power BI custom visuals, Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, Figma or equivalent design tooling; Git, DevOps and CI/CD data workflows. Microsoft certification (e.g. PL-300 Power BI Data Analyst, DP-500/DP-600) or working towards. Experience in a transportation, operations, SaaS or managed services environment; knowledge of ServiceNow data models. Experience with SAP BusinessObjects (WebI, Universes, Crystal Reports) – good to have; experience migrating from SAP BI to Power BI is a plus. Agile, ITIL and PRINCE2 experience. Soft Skills Strong analytical mindset with exceptional problem-solving abilities. Design sensibility and attention to detail, with a user-first approach to analytics. Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables. Excellent communication skills – able to simplify complex concepts for non-technical stakeholders. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, global, multi-time zone team, including regular collaboration with UK colleagues. Proactive, resourceful and committed to high-quality outcomes. Role Impact & Success Measures The Senior BI Developer will directly support CTS’s global analytics capability and the TOC program by delivering high-quality, well-designed analytical assets and insights, strengthening KPI/SLA measurement and enabling data-driven decision-making. Success is defined by strong analytical delivery, reliable data models, usable and trusted dashboards, and meaningful contributions to operational initiatives. Success in the First 3–6 Months Build a solid understanding of CTS datasets, KPI frameworks, TOC reporting requirements and the Azure SQL and Oracle data landscape. Integrate with the CDI team and the UK BI Team Lead, agreeing working practices across time zones. Deliver first Power BI assets to agreed design and quality standards, and support program teams with timely analysis. Success in 6–12 Months Take ownership of end-to-end Power BI workstreams with minimal supervision. Establish reusable semantic models, templates and design standards that improve delivery speed and consistency. Improve reporting efficiency by automating repetitive tasks. Build strong relationships with global stakeholders and act as a trusted reporting and analytics partner. Long-Term Success (12+ Months) Contribute to CTS Analytics strategy, standards and global operating model improvements. Become a subject matter expert in CTS operational datasets and Power BI solution architecture. Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance data quality, automation, design quality and analytical maturity. Provide mentoring and technical leadership to uplift junior team members. ‎ Worker Type: Employee ‎ We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic under applicable law.
